Look, I check names at the door, not reviews. But I've seen enough shady characters to spot a plant when I see one.

The actual review says two words: "Great product."

The rest of it? That's somebody slipping a note in the text trying to change the rules of the joint. Not happening. The list is the list, and a review says what it says — "Great product!" — and nothing more.

Now, you on the list tonight or not?
